exercises.instruction: Write sentences with both … and … / neither … nor … / either … or … .

answers: Both Chris and Pat were late.
He neither said hello nor smiled.
The movie was both boring and long.

items.prompt: (Joe / not have a car / Sam / not have one either)
answers: Neither Joe nor Sam has a car.
Neither Joe nor Sam has got a car.
Emily speaks both German and Russian.

items.prompt: (Ben / not watch TV / not read newspapers)
answers: Ben neither watches TV nor reads newspapers.
That man’s name is either Richard or Robert.

items.prompt: (I / not have time / not have money)
answers: I have neither the time nor the money to go on holiday.
We can leave either today or tomorrow.
